name: AI memory update
oneLiner: a glass chat: the user states a preference, the assistant answers and a Memory updated chip pops in under it, a pointer opens it and the memory panel rises out of the chip over the dimmed chat, the saved memories step down a slot and the new one drops in on top, lit with a New tag while the count ticks
say: when the speaker says the AI remembers them ('tell it once and it remembers', 'it already knows how I like it'): the chip pops on 'remembers', the new memory drops in on the payoff
